<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_ITSolutionRequest"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/it-solution-request">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ITSolutionRequest" name="IT solution request"/>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_ITSolutionRequest" name="Provide an IT solution" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_RequestSubmitted" name="IT solution request submitted">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_RequestSubmitted" messageRef="Message_ITSolutionRequest"/>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_Assess</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssessRequest" name="Assess the request for compatibility, cost, and resource needs">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_Assess</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Assess_Approval</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Approval" name="Request approved?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Assess_Approval</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Approval_Procure</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Approval_NotApproved</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:default>Flow_Approval_NotApproved</bpmn:default>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Procure" name="Procure necessary tools or licenses">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Approval_Procure</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Procure_Install</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Install" name="Install the solution">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Procure_Install</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Install_Test</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Test" name="Test the solution in a controlled environment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Install_Test</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Test_Rollout</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Rollout" name="Roll out the solution to the requesting department">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Test_Rollout</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Rollout_TrainingChoice</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TrainingChoice" name="Provide training?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Rollout_TrainingChoice</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TrainingChoice_Provide</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TrainingChoice_Skip</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProvideTraining" name="Provide training">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TrainingChoice_Provide</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Training_Merge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TrainingMerge" name="Continue after training choice">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Training_Merge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TrainingChoice_Skip</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TrainingMerge_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_SolutionAvailable" name="Solution rolled out; IT support remains available for troubleshooting">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TrainingMerge_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NotApproved" name="Request not approved">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Approval_NotApproved</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Assess" sourceRef="StartEvent_RequestSubmitted" targetRef="Task_AssessRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Assess_Approval" sourceRef="Task_AssessRequest" targetRef="Gateway_Approval"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approval_Procure" name="Approved" sourceRef="Gateway_Approval" targetRef="Task_Procure">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">approved</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approval_NotApproved" name="Not approved" sourceRef="Gateway_Approval" targetRef="EndEvent_NotApproved"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Procure_Install" sourceRef="Task_Procure" targetRef="Task_Install"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Install_Test" sourceRef="Task_Install" targetRef="Task_Test"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Test_Rollout" sourceRef="Task_Test" targetRef="Task_Rollout"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Rollout_TrainingChoice" sourceRef="Task_Rollout" targetRef="Gateway_TrainingChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TrainingChoice_Provide" name="Training provided" sourceRef="Gateway_TrainingChoice" targetRef="Task_ProvideTraining"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TrainingChoice_Skip" name="No training" sourceRef="Gateway_TrainingChoice" targetRef="Gateway_TrainingMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Training_Merge" sourceRef="Task_ProvideTraining" targetRef="Gateway_TrainingMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TrainingMerge_End" sourceRef="Gateway_TrainingMerge" targetRef="EndEvent_SolutionAvailable"/>
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_ITSolutionRequest">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Requester" name="Employee or department"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_IT" name="IT" processRef="Process_ITSolutionRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Request" name="Submit IT solution request" sourceRef="Participant_Requester" targetRef="StartEvent_RequestSubmitted" messageRef="Message_ITSolutionRequest"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_Procure" name="Procure necessary tools or licenses">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Approval_Procure</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Procure_Install</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Install" name="Install the solution">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Procure_Install</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Install_Test</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Test" name="Test the solution in a controlled environment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Install_Test</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Test_Rollout</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Rollout" name="Roll out the solution to the requesting department">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Test_Rollout</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Rollout_TrainingChoice</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TrainingChoice" name="Provide training?" default="Flow_TrainingChoice_Skip">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Rollout_TrainingChoice</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TrainingChoice_Provide</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TrainingChoice_Skip</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProvideTraining" name="Provide training">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TrainingChoice_Provide</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Training_Merge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TrainingMerge" name="Merge training alternatives">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Training_Merge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TrainingChoice_Skip</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TrainingMerge_Support</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ITSupport" name="Provide IT support for troubleshooting">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TrainingMerge_Support</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Support_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_SolutionProvided" name="IT solution provided">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Support_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NotApproved" name="Assessment ended">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Approval_NotApproved</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RequestReceived_Assess" sourceRef="StartEvent_RequestReceived" targetRef="Task_AssessRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Assess_CheckCompatibility" sourceRef="Task_AssessRequest" targetRef="Task_CheckCompatibility"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckCompatibility_EvaluateNeeds" sourceRef="Task_CheckCompatibility" targetRef="Task_EvaluateNeeds"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EvaluateNeeds_Approval" sourceRef="Task_EvaluateNeeds" targetRef="Gateway_Approval"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approval_Procure" name="Approved" sourceRef="Gateway_Approval" targetRef="Task_Procure">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">approved</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approval_NotApproved" name="Not approved" sourceRef="Gateway_Approval" targetRef="EndEvent_NotApproved"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Procure_Install" sourceRef="Task_Procure" targetRef="Task_Install"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Install_Test" sourceRef="Task_Install" targetRef="Task_Test"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Test_Rollout" sourceRef="Task_Test" targetRef="Task_Rollout"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Rollout_TrainingChoice" sourceRef="Task_Rollout" targetRef="Gateway_TrainingChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TrainingChoice_Provide" name="Training provided" sourceRef="Gateway_TrainingChoice" targetRef="Task_ProvideTraining">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">trainingProvided</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TrainingChoice_Skip" name="No training" sourceRef="Gateway_TrainingChoice" targetRef="Gateway_TrainingMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Training_Merge" sourceRef="Task_ProvideTraining" targetRef="Gateway_TrainingMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TrainingMerge_Support" sourceRef="Gateway_TrainingMerge" targetRef="Task_ITSupport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Support_End" sourceRef="Task_ITSupport" targetRef="EndEvent_SolutionProvided"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
